caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a beige background and consists of three separate technical views of a child's living room chair, labeled as "Top Elevation," "Side Elevation," and "Front Elevation." The top elevation, located at the upper left, shows the chair from above, indicating measurements of 15 3/4 inches in width and 13 3/4 inches in depth, with 11 3/4 inches separating the armrests from front to back; the seat area is shaded with diagonal lines. On the lower left is the side elevation, depicting the chair from the left side; the drawing shows the armrest, backrest, seat cushion, and detailed turned legs and stretchers, with dimensions provided. On the lower right, the front elevation displays the chair from the front, indicating the same detailed turned legs and stretchers, armrests, a rectangular backrest, and a seat cushion, with a total height of 26 1/2 inches. The drawing includes labels, handwritten notes, a scale bar labeled “Scale 1/6" = 1", and a class number identification. All elements, including the objects and annotations, are presented in a consistent monochromatic style with precise linework.
title: Chair
